integrity: The exact mathematical proof and a standalone, executable finite cross-check are embedded. Original work is not independently audited or certified.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear words of Hamming weight exactly three; full noiseless scattered-subsequence length-three profile. Does not cover higher Hamming weights, general alphabets, circular words, or incomplete/noisy decks. Priority limited by accessible source inspections.
title: Exact weight-three binary three-decks: a gap-swap classification and generating function
